rationale: Joseph brings hands-on robotics experience from agricultural robotics (Nupeak) and early-stage tech, while Shiza is building at the intersection of humanoid robotics, haptics, and applied ML—and explicitly values operators and industrialists who can deploy robotics in the real world, not just research it. As a judge at a Physical AI hackathon, Shiza could offer perspective on what makes robotics projects actually work in practice, and Joseph's background in agri-robotics deployment could inform how she thinks about real-world robotics integration.
intro_message: Joseph Zheng, meet Shiza Charania — she's a roboticist and founder (Haptile, ex-1X) who believes deployment requires a different skillset than research, and your experience shipping robotics at Nupeak could spark a useful conversation about what actually works in the field.
